review_status: Agent development review only; no human or clinical acceptance.
scope: All fifty passages from the ten already executed public development queries; content read against each question.
offset_unit: Unicode code points; half-open [start, end). Topic offsets refer to canonical cleaned_summary; passage offsets refer to its unchanged retrieved slice.
limitations: Questions were previously selected by inspecting this corpus and prior support assessments were visible; this is not blinded or held-out evaluation.
No second reviewer, human gold labels, clinical validation, answer-generation measurement, calibrated threshold, or topic-recall metric is claimed.
Missing support means absent from the five inspected passages, not proven absent from the entire corpus or external literature.
Review labels are A-owned research annotations, not canonical API states or D-owned evaluation annotations.
Quote/offset validity establishes traceability; semantic labels remain coding-agent judgments requiring independent review.
